hints: Use what it means for P and Q to be isotopes of the same element.
The identity of an element is set by its proton number; isotopes differ in their neutron numbers.
walkthrough: P and Q are isotopes of the same element, so they have the same number of protons.
Isotopes have different numbers of neutrons in their nuclei.
Therefore, P and Q have equal proton numbers and unequal neutron numbers.

ai_rubric.observable: States that nuclei P and Q have the same number of protons.
States that nuclei P and Q have different numbers of neutrons.

hints: The emitted β⁻ particle tells you that this is beta-minus decay, in which a neutron changes into a proton.
Compare the neutron composition udd with the proton composition uud to identify the one quark-flavour change.
walkthrough: A β⁻ decay changes a neutron into a proton.
A neutron has quark composition udd, whereas a proton has quark composition uud.
Therefore one down quark changes into an up quark: udd → uud.

ai_rubric.observable: States that a down quark changes into an up quark, or gives the equivalent udd to uud change.

hints: The emitted β⁻ particle identifies the process as beta-minus decay.
Recall the neutral lepton emitted with the electron in beta-minus decay, rather than the neutrino produced in beta-plus decay.
walkthrough: A β⁻ particle is an electron emitted in beta-minus decay.
Beta-minus decay also produces an electron antineutrino.
Therefore the additional emitted particle is an electron antineutrino.

ai_rubric.observable: States that an electron antineutrino is emitted.

hints: Recall the charges of charm and bottom quarks in units of e.
Add the charges of two charm quarks and one bottom quark, keeping the signs.
walkthrough: A charm quark has charge +2e/3 and a bottom quark has charge −e/3.
Adding the bottom-quark charge gives +4e/3 − e/3 = +e.

ai_rubric.observable: States a correct constituent charge, such as +2e/3 for a charm quark, +4e/3 for two charm quarks, or −e/3 for a bottom quark.
Adds two +2e/3 charm-quark charges and one −e/3 bottom-quark charge to obtain +1e.
